trigger: The operator dispatched py -3.10 -m runner --run-id <id> --node 8d. n08d assembled part_b_assembled_draft.json from the three released section artifacts and reached blocked_at_exit. gate_10d passed 6 of 7 deterministic predicates and failed g09d_p07 (cross_section_consistency) with three issues, all of check deliverable_kpi_alignment.

F16_the_kpi_table_named_deliverables_by_.what: _check_deliverable_kpi_alignment holds that when a KPI-linked deliverable id appears anywhere in the Impact section, that deliverable's canonical title must appear in the Impact section too. Its purpose is to catch a KPI being described AS its deliverable. The impact sub-section B.2.1 carries a twelve-row quantified-estimates table whose Indicator column holds KPI wording and whose Deliverable column held a bare id. D2.1, D4.1 and D4.4 therefore appeared with no canonical title anywhere in Impact, and the check read that as possible conflation.
F16_the_kpi_table_named_deliverables_by_.why_only_three_of_twelve_failed: The check fires only for deliverables reachable from a KPI's traceable_to_deliverable field. The other nine rows name deliverables with no such KPI link, or whose canonical title already appeared elsewhere in the section.
F16_the_kpi_table_named_deliverables_by_.fix: All twelve rows of the Deliverable column now carry the canonical title alongside the id, read from canonical_reference_pack.json. Naming all twelve rather than the three that failed makes the table self-describing, which the prose profile also asks of a table, and removes the dependency on which deliverables happen to carry a KPI link.
F16_the_kpi_table_named_deliverables_by_.not_a_content_change: No claim, number or assertion changed. The edit adds canonical titles already held in the reference pack.

verification_before_dispatch.method: proposal_sections/ was copied to a scratch directory, impact_section.json patched with the corrected B.2.1 draft exactly as the assembler will write it, and cross_section_consistency run against the patched directory. No Claude call, no canonical write.

sequencing.why_n08b_is_rerun: The correction lives in section_drafts/impact/B.2.1.draft.json, so the canonical impact_section.json must be regenerated by the assembler. Editing the Tier 5 artifact directly would leave gate_10b's recorded result stale against the artifact's content fingerprint (ST-1) and put a provenance hole where a free ten-minute rerun belongs.
